title: dryopteris thelypteris f. suaveolens
intro: Dryopteris thelypteris f. suaveolens, commonly known as the woodland lady fern, is a fern species belonging to the Dryopteris genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of the woodland lady fern include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and potential health benefits.
